sn45.57-61:1.1: “Monks, this is the forerunner, the harbinger of the rising of the sun, i.e., dawnrise.
sn45.57-61:1.2: In the same way, this is the forerunner, the harbinger of the arising of the noble eightfold path in a monk, i.e., virtue-consummation…
sn45.57-61:1.4: self-consummation [according to the Commentary, this means being consummate in the training of the mind]…
